scope.external: Days 1 to 13: internet-facing assets only, a person approves each step past the first
scope.internal: From day 14: corporate network added under the same rules of engagement

paths.title: Corporate VPN to the domain controller

steps.misconfig: Admin credentials cached on the VPN appliance also work on the IT jump host
Jump host admin group has RDP rights on the domain controller

paths.evidence: Validation agent reached an authenticated shell on the VPN appliance, then logged on to the jump host and opened an RDP session to the domain controller with read-only rights under the rules of engagement.

paths.title: Field office VPN to the domain controller

steps.misconfig: File server holds a cached domain admin logon

paths.evidence: Out-of-bounds write on the SSL-VPN gave a foothold; the print spooler flaw on the file server gave SYSTEM, where a cached domain admin logon was present.

paths.title: Contractor gateway to the email server
paths.evidence: Session tokens leaked by the gateway allowed a contractor session to be taken over; from there the email server answered the server-side request forgery check.

paths.title: Plant edge firewall to the data historian

steps.misconfig: The OT jump host shares its local admin password with the firewall's management account
Historian accepts logons from the OT jump host

paths.evidence: Command injection on the GlobalProtect portal was confirmed, and the firewall's management password matches the OT jump host's local admin password, which the historian accepts. The agent stopped at the OT boundary and did not log on to the jump host or the historian.

retest_notes.12: Patched on the primary interface; the GlobalProtect portal on the secondary interface was still on the old version.

paths.title: Vendor file exchange data exposure
paths.evidence: SQL injection in the file transfer web app was confirmed with a read of the version table only.

paths.title: Partner wiki takeover
paths.evidence: The setup endpoint that allows creating an administrator account was reachable from the internet; the agent stopped before creating an account.

paths.title: Remote support console to the virtualization cluster
paths.evidence: The remote support setup wizard was reachable without authentication; hypervisor hosts trust a directory group the support console can create.

paths.title: Substation router to the EMS data link

steps.misconfig: No access list between the substation comms network and the EMS data link

paths.evidence: The router's web UI is reachable from the internet and on an affected version; a route to the EMS data link exists with no access list. No traffic was sent to the EMS link.
paths.hold_note: Router upgrade needs an OT change window, scheduled for day 35.

paths.title: Outage map API remote code execution
paths.evidence: A harmless lookup string in a request header triggered an outbound DNS query from the outage map API.

paths.title: Firewall manager takeover from the corporate network
paths.evidence: The firewall manager's device registration port answered from the corporate user network on an affected version.

paths.title: Domain controller Netlogon from the corporate network
paths.evidence: The domain controller runs an affected version and accepts Netlogon secure channels from corporate workstations; the agent confirmed the version only and made no change.

paths.title: Corporate network to the EMS data link through the OT jump host

steps.misconfig: OT jump host accepts RDP from the whole corporate network with no multi-factor prompt
EMS data link trusts logons from the OT jump host

paths.evidence: An RDP logon prompt on the OT jump host was reachable from a corporate desktop VLAN with password-only sign-in. The agent did not attempt a logon.
paths.hold_note: Restricting RDP and adding MFA on the OT jump host needs an OT change window, scheduled for day 35.
